subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The CEO announced that / the company's profits has / fallen significantly / in the last quarter.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'the company’s profits has'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **'the company’s profits has'.**
 
• The given sentence has an error of **'Verb'.**
 
• Generally, we use **'Has in Singular subject and Have in Plural subjects'.**
 
• Here, the subject of the sentence **'****the company's profits'** is in **'Plural'.** So, instead of **'Has'** we should use **'Have'** to make it correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

**Correct sentence:**__ *The CEO announced that the company's profits **have** fallen significantly in the last quarter.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'The CEO announced that'** is the correct part of the sentence.
 
• **'fallen significantly'** is the correct part of the sentence.
 
• **'in the last quarter' **is the correct part of the sentence.
